Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

JIG FEET WITH CYLINDRICAL SHANK 



1 . Scope — Covers dimensions and material for jig feet with cylindrical shank with interference fit.

IS : 11278 -1985 

3. IVAaterial — Steel having tensile strength of 370 IVlPa M/n. 

3.1 The contact face D, if agreed to between the manufacturer and the user, shall be hardened to 
550 HV, Mm. 

4. Designation — A jig foot having D == 20 mm and length A = 25 mm shall be designated as: 

Jig Foot 20 X 25 IS : 11278 

5. Finish — Jig feet shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable anticorrosive surface treatment shall be given to jig feet. 

6.2 Jig feet shall be packed in suitable cartons so as to prevent damage during transit. 

7. Marking — The carton containing the jig feet shall be marked with the dimensions D and /j and the 
manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 

7.1 iS/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been prepared based upon experience of our industry and is an alternative to 
IS :. 4299-1982 'Specification for Jig feet' which hav^ threaded shanks.
